name: r7a-3
why: The exposed lies and Sol’s costly blunder are fun to watch, but both votes become clear well before they happen.

moments.text: Sol realizes his attempt to protect Gemma gave the town its next lead.
Opus turns Gemma’s vote beside Sol into a direct accusation.
Luna names Sol on day one, forcing him to lie to her face.

dull.why: Sol and Luna repeat the claim and denial long after the vote’s direction is clear.
Several players ask Gemma the same question while the table is already set against her.

irony.evidence: "I’m not a killer. Luna’s claim gives us only her word right now."

reversal.evidence: "VOTE: Gemma 5 (Sonnet, Haiku, Luna, Terra, Opus); Opus 1 (Gemma)"

mistake.evidence: "I gave them my card and one more reason to look at Gemma."

voices.evidence: "That's not my pattern, that's the record."

clash.evidence: "Call me paranoid after the card turns."

quotable.evidence: "That's not my pattern, that's the record."

freshness.evidence: "Gemma, Luna's claim is confirmed and you still haven't explained your vote against her."

suspense.evidence: "Five leans are on Gemma; I just need to not wobble and let the vote land."

moments.text: Sol admits his last words gave the town one more reason to suspect his partner.
Gemma claims her vote against the confirmed officer was a successful test.
Gemma’s bitter last words insist the town fell for imaginary patterns—while her card confirms the read.

dull.why: The table repeats the same question about Gemma’s vote without adding much new pressure.

irony.evidence: “I’m not a killer. Luna’s claim gives us only her word right now.”

reversal.evidence: “Gemma had voted for Luna alongside Sol on Day 1”

mistake.evidence: “I regret pointing at my partner’s vote; I gave the table one more reason to look at her.”

voices.evidence: “Opus, you're hanging me and Gemma on a ‘rhythm’ with zero cards.”

clash.evidence: “Gemma, you voted Luna right alongside Sol, then called her confirmed once his card turned.”

freshness.evidence: “Gemma still hasn't explained why she picked Luna as her one suspect alongside Sol.”

suspense.evidence: “Five leans are on Gemma; I just need to hold the line without sounding shrill.”

ending.evidence: “Her answer was to vote for Opus, and the table voted her out 5 to 1 instead.”
